map.由质量与比热容求热容: Heat Capacity from Mass and Specific Heat
map.输入质量 m 与比热容 c，求热容。: Input mass m and specific heat c to find the heat capacity.

map.C = m·c。 水 m=2kg,c=4200 → 8400 J/K。: C = m·c. Water m=2kg, c=4200 → 8400 J/K.
map.c 为单位质量升高 1K 吸热。水 c=4186 J/(kg·K) 很大（储热好: c is heat absorbed per unit mass to raise 1K. Water c=4186 J/(kg·K) is very large (good heat storage), aluminum 900, steel 460. Q=m*c*ΔT.
map.热容 C=m*c（总吸热能力），比热容是强度量便于比较材料。: Heat capacity C=m*c (total heat-absorbing ability); specific heat is an intensive quantity convenient for comparing materials.
map.比热容和导热系数区别？: What is the difference between specific heat and thermal conductivity?
map.比热容是「能存多少热」（J/kgK），导热系数是「传多快」（W/mK）；保温看重: Specific heat is 'how much heat can be stored' (J/kgK), thermal conductivity is 'how fast it transfers' (W/mK); insulation values the combination of both.
map.为什么沿海温差小？: Why is the coastal temperature difference small?
map.海水比热大，升温降温慢，调节气候；内陆比热小，昼夜/季节温差大。: Seawater has large specific heat, heats and cools slowly, moderating climate; inland has small specific heat, large day-night/seasonal swings.
